newsitem.title: USA: Ennis Cosby buried after private funeral.
newsitem.headline: Ennis Cosby buried after private funeral.

text.p: Ennis William Cosby, the son of entertainer Bill Cosby, was buried at his family's estate in Massachusetts after a private funeral Sunday, three days after he was killed by an unidentified gunman.

Cosby's agent Norman Brokaw said in a statement that Cosby, his wife, his four daughters and Ennis Cosby's friend Phil Caputo and a companion attended the funeral service in Shelburne Falls, Massachusetts.
"The body was interred on the grounds of the estate," a family spokesman said.

Ennis Cosby, a 27-year-old Columbia University graduate student, was gunned down early on Thursday morning while changing a flat tire on a darkened roadside along a southern California freeway. He died of a single gunshot wound to the head.
Police have mounted a massive manhunt but have so far failed to capture the killer. Investigators believe robbery was the motive, and a composite sketch of the suspect was released on Saturday.
At the Cosby family's request, the body was released on Saturday from the Los Angeles County morgue following an autopsy.
